neighbours.label: The token ' Q' or ' Qu': a word-initial capital Q in a name or initial
fire: The essay by Martin Q. Barlow was reprinted in the spring issue of the journal.
Her new translation was praised by the critic Helen Qu in a long review.
The flight from Sydney on Qantas landed two hours late because of heavy fog.
A portrait of Robert Q. Hale hangs in the lobby of the county courthouse.
The lecture was given by Professor Wei Qu of the university's history department.
Tourists often visit Qatar and Oman on the same trip through the Gulf.
The report cites an earlier paper by Sandra Qiu and Thomas Q. Larkin.
Records from the village show that a farmer named Peter Quigley owned the mill.
